meta.name: muapi-nano-banana
meta.description: Reasoning-driven image generation using structured creative briefs (Gemini 3 style) — generates high-fidelity images via muapi.ai with logic-based prompting

copy.tagline: 用结构化创意简报生成高质量图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过逻辑提示词生成高保真图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-fidelity images using structured creative briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-fidelity images with logic-based prompts

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用结构化创意简报（主题+动作+环境+构图+光照+风格）生成高质量图片，并自动优化提示词，避免关键词堆砌，确保物理一致性和文字精准。
howto.when: 当你要求生成图片，或描述一个场景、物体时，Claude 会触发该技能，将你的描述转化为逻辑驱动的提示词。

say.text: 生成一张机器人咖啡师在霓虹咖啡馆里拉花的图片。
say.note: Claude 会按结构化简报生成提示词并调用脚本。

say.text: 画一个玻璃棋子碎成液体碎片，放在黑曜石桌上。
say.note: Claude 会解析物理逻辑并生成图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses structured creative briefs (subject + action + context + composition + lighting + style) to generate high-fidelity images, automatically optimizing prompts to avoid keyword stuffing and ensure physical consistency and text precision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request image generation or describe a scene/object; Claude converts your description into a logic-driven prompt.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a robot barista pouring latte art in a neon-lit cafe.
say_en.note: Claude will create a structured brief and call the script.

say_en.text: Draw a glass chess piece shattering into liquid shards on an obsidian table.
say_en.note: Claude will parse physics logic and generate the image.
